name: Solar and electrical paperwork: network connection applications and environmental certificates (STCs, VEECs, LGCs)
summary: Tracks solar and electrical jobs that need network or certificate paperwork, checks each job for the evidence it needs, and queues a chase to the customer when something is missing. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email.

solar-install-paperwork.evidence: 2 discovery calls; the variants file is missing from the mining folder, so the step map comes from the platforms file and the workflow spec

crons.name: register
crons.summary: Track active jobs whose text names solar, battery or certificate paperwork.

crons.name: evidence
crons.summary: Check each tracked job's attachments for the evidence it needs and record what is missing.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Queue one chase email per job still missing evidence, for approval. Nothing is sent by the cron.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. The store holds the checklist, which reaches nobody outside the business. The one live operation, a chase email, is only ever queued.

servicem8.covers: job list, job attachments as the evidence check, primary contact, queued chase email

gaps: No platform in the evidence has a mapped operation. The REC Registry and Solar Accreditation Australia pages describe certificates and installer accreditation only, and the kit has no adapter for either.
Network connection applications (prepare and lodge) and distributor approval waits have no mapped platform. They stay manual, with the agent skill helping with the form content.
The REC Registry certificate creation form, evidence upload and claim lodgement are not in the evidence pages. Confirm on a live account before any adapter is written.
VEEC claims (Victorian Energy Upgrades) and LGC claims have no platform in the evidence; they are not covered.
Accreditation checks use the public registered-person search only. Installer accreditation sits with Solar Accreditation Australia, which has no mapped operations.
The variants file (construction-env-certificates-variants.json) is missing from the mining folder, so the call evidence is 2 calls and the step weights are unverified.
The ServiceM8 adapter is docs-only until a ServiceM8 trial account proves the job, attachment and contact reads.

evidence.calls: 2 discovery calls (per the worklist); variants file missing
evidence.platforms: rec-registry and solar-accreditation-australia: 0 mapped operations, 0 kit adapters
